items.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother will make you forget all about Marvel’s Blade disaster
items.summary: Marvel's mishandling of its Blade reboot will likely go down as one of the studio's biggest mistakes. There was a great actor in place to play the vampire hunter (Mahershala Ali), and a promising director set to take over the reins (Bassam Tariq).
